panel.title: Sync
panel.description: Entries are encrypted on this device; the server only ever sees ciphertext.
panel.pending: Everything is sent | {n} entry waiting to be sent | {n} entries waiting to be sent
panel.offline: Can’t reach the server. Entries are saved on this device and will be sent when you’re back online.
panel.off: Sync works while you’re signed in to your account.
panel.otherTab: Another open impact log tab is syncing.
panel.paused: Sync is paused while the encryption key is being changed and will resume on its own.

quota.title: Plan limit reached
quota.text: {n} entries are not synced: the {plan} plan stores up to {limit} entries in the cloud. They are saved on this device. | {n} entry is not synced: the {plan} plan stores up to {limit} entries in the cloud. It is saved on this device. | {n} entries are not synced: the {plan} plan stores up to {limit} entries in the cloud. They are saved on this device.
quota.hint: Delete entries you don’t need or change your plan — sync will resume on its own.

errors.INVALID: The server rejected one of the entries. It is saved on this device.
errors.TOO_LARGE: One of the entries is too large to sync. It is saved on this device.
errors.VAULT_LOCKED: The vault is locked — reload the page.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. We’ll try again shortly.
errors.ACCOUNT_MISMATCH: The session open in this browser belongs to a different account. Sync is stopped; entries on this device are untouched. Sign in again to the account this device is linked to, then press “Sync now”.
errors.generic: The server returned an error ({code}). We’ll retry automatically.
errors.KEY_CHANGED: The encryption key was changed on another device — sign in again. Entries on this device are untouched: after you sign in they switch to the new key.

conflicts.title: Sync conflicts
conflicts.description: These entries were changed on two devices at the same time. Both versions are kept — choose which one to keep.
conflicts.deletedServer: This entry was deleted on another device.
conflicts.deletedLocal: This entry was deleted on this device.
conflicts.undecryptable: This version could not be decrypted.
conflicts.confirmDelete: Delete this entry on all devices?
conflicts.failed: Couldn’t resolve the conflict. Please try again.
conflicts.changedMeanwhile: The entry changed while you were choosing. Check both versions again.
